response.sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT o.timespan, AVG(f.rebrate / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS order_count FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), threshold AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_order_count FROM grouped) SELECT AVG(g.avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_ratios, SUM(g.order_count) AS total_distinct_orders, AVG(g.order_count - t.avg_order_count) AS avg_count_excess FROM grouped AS g CROSS JOIN threshold AS t WHERE g.order_count > t.avg_order_count;

assumptions.assumption: A zero fee rate makes the ratio undefined, so that ratio is excluded from the averages.
